brief:
The UN Palestinian refugee agency called for safeguards for humanitarian workers following a deadly attack that targeted staff members, Middle East Eye reported. The agency did not specify the number of casualties or provide additional details about the incident in the available summary.

Unrwa's demand comes as tensions remain high over the security of aid workers operating in conflict zones. The agency has previously raised concerns about the safety of its personnel during escalating violence in the region.

title: UN agency demands protection for staff after Israeli attack
